Question
========
What is the correct way to iterate through the indices of the list `my_list`?

Answerlist
-----------
* `for i in my_list:`
* `for i in range(len(my_list)):`
* `for i in list(range(my_list)):`
* `for i in my_list.indices():`
* `while i < my_list:`
* `for i in enumerate(my_list):`

Solution
========
To loop over indices, use `for i in range(len(my_list)):`.
